# Posting Direction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PostingDirection`](gmeow-PostingDirection.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PostingDirection>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The direction of a posting in double-entry bookkeeping — a VALUE, never a subclass. Only debit and credit are seeded; the vocabulary is closed in practice but modelled as open for consistency.

Use [`gmeow:PostingDirection`](gmeow-PostingDirection.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
